author: Corridor Crew
description: This scene from The Punisher: One Last Kill (2026) took a lot of online heat for its CGi quality. But what if we told you that 90% of what you're seeing was actually filmed in-camera? This shot is a great example of how a CGi-looking result can come from some poor choices in performance, directing, and editing, rather than from bad CGi itself.
title: It looks SO CGi, but IT'S REAL
